title: Binary subformat carrying an encoding parameter

source.note: composed: `audio/wav;base64` is ECMA-432 Example 3's subformat. The content kind is `audio` and the encoding part `wav;base64` is non-empty, so nothing is reported — the crate does not parse inside the encoding part.

notes: The Warning is `ecma430-5.3/binary-encoding-parameter`, not binary-content-kind (`audio` is a known kind) and not binary-encoding (the encoding part is non-empty). Paired with ecma-432/02, which records the same subformat as ECMA-432 §8 Example 3 sends it.
